scientific_integrity: Analytical global Rayleigh upper certificate, explicit attaining spectrum and real chord-independence uniqueness proof; finite checks are reproducibility aids, not exhaustive or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Even cycles with two strictly positive alternating conductance prices, a linear unit budget, and symmetric continuous-time generator only; no claim for odd cycles, arbitrary price patterns, or discrete-time eigenvalue modulus. Finite checker instances do not certify the infinite theorem. Historical equivalence in less accessible specialized literature remains possible.
title: Square-root price geometry for fastest mixing on alternating even cycles
